prompt: CUTSTACK SKYPORT for Glaze. ONE original1024x1024 separate pure artwork of a tangible invented aerial public-transit utility. FLAT LAYERED REVERSE-APPLIQUE COTTON: thin saturated cloth layers CUT BACK to reveal underlayers as nested colour contour channels, neatly rolled-back cut edges held by close tiny irregular hand stitches, fine cotton weave and fibres, very slight edge lift, completely UNPADDED. A thin2mm stitched fabric silhouette, not stuffed/quilted/plush toys, crochet, filled embroidery, leather, paper cutout, resin or CGI3D model. Subject HINGE STEP BOARDING BRIDGE: one WIDE LOW FOLDING STAIRWAY CONNECTOR between two compact pierced-arch docking piers. Strong wide zigzag silhouette, no giant wings, sail, shell/hangar, basket, cloud or ground tile. Actual functional folding skyport access bridge, not generic abstract staircase. All pier tips, handrails, tread corners, hinges, locking levers and feet well inside broad alpha.
